text:
Elder Scrolls Oblivion Nintendo Switch 2 UNBOXING
Over a year after shadow dropping on most consoles in Spring 2025, The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered has made the jump to Nintendo Switch 2.

Revealed during the February 2026 Nintendo Direct Partner Showcase, the Switch 2 version of Oblivion Remastered will include all the same content as the other platforms, and there will be a $60 physical Deluxe Edition that adds in additional weapons, armor, and other cosmetics. More importantly, the Switch 2 release includes the full game data on the cartridge–it is not a Game Key-Card release.
